driverProbe.availabilityNote: OptimoRoute exposes no read endpoint for per-date driver availability (get_drivers and get_vehicles both return AUTH_KEY_UNKNOWN on this key; get_drivers_parameters is 404). Enabled/disabled state for 09-21..24 is therefore UNVERIFIED and the live run must set it explicitly.

freezeRule: jobber-to-optimo-sync emailCutoffOk(): a date is frozen once it is today or past, and tomorrow freezes at 14:00 PT today. It is a clock rule — it does not check whether notifications actually went out.

loadCaveat: cycleMinPerStop is first-customer-arrival to last-customer-departure divided by visits. The home commute at each end is NOT in it. Both receiving techs are being sent to ground they do not normally drive, so add their commute separately before reading any hours figure as a working day.
